human_product_lead_report: In normal play, R used to rotate camera right; after Control 1B it no longer rotates.

root_cause.finding: exploration allow-list contains rotate_camera_left but omits rotate_camera_right
root_cause.runtime_effect: ControlContextRouter.is_action_just_pressed('rotate_camera_right') fails closed, so cozy_camera never observes R in exploration
root_cause.why_prior_tests_missed_it: tests proved exploration R did not rotate a hologram and avoided dual-fire, but did not assert camera yaw changes through the real InputMap path

prior_machine_evidence.status: superseded by Human live-play regression evidence for R camera rotation
